highlights: Ugreen NW120 (50961) Cat 6 Unshielded RJ45 Modular Plug - 10 Pack
Material: Pure copper pins, 24K gold plated
Ugreen NW120 (50961) Cat 6 Unshielded RJ45 Modular Plug - 10 Pack provides reliable connections for Cat6 and Cat6e network cables.
These RJ45 connectors provide pure copper pins plated with 24K gold, excellent signal conduction, and minimal interference, thus guaranteeing the stable performance of the network.
The crystal plastic-made shell is solid and resistant to breakage during installation. This reduces waste and makes it last.
This is a great pack, with 10 modular plugs, for small projects or professional network installations.
These connectors are compatible with Cat6 and Cat6e cables to create custom-length Ethernet cables or repair existing ones.
The unshielded design is ideal for normal networking setups for which a shield is not needed; thus, it stays flexible and is easy to work with.
